input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('.claude/skills')
for sf in sorted(root.glob('*/SKILL.md')):
    txt=sf.read_text(errors='ignore')[:1000]
    # print skill and frontmatter-ish lines containing author/owner/created
    lines=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines()[:30]:
        if re.search(r'author|owner|contributor|创建|提交|维护|by|name:', line, re.I):
            lines.append(line)
    if lines:
        print('##', sf.parent.name)
        print('\n'.join(lines))
PY
